servers.S3 baseline: http://127.0.0.1:5312 (git archive 7222794, exported and served in the same session)

honesty: Every capture here is a sandbox capture: no GPU, no phone, Pixi CanvasRenderer under --disable-3d-apis. No visual or performance claim here has been confirmed by an eye or a device.
recapture: Every picture in this folder was taken again after the review of 2026-09-21: the atlas changed (the plus sign's arms, the smile's spacing, the dust strip's opacity and tone), the coin burst's launch speeds changed, and the sleeper's mark was dropped. The numbers in the .json files beside the pictures are from those same runs.
videoNote: The four .webm files decode (the browser reports 15.28 s / 1280x720 and 15.44 s / 412x914) but this sandbox has no ffmpeg and its headless Chromium paints no decoded video frame either to a canvas or into a screenshot, so the recordings could not be looked at here. The 84 ms still series covers the same moment and was looked at.
notTaken: The deliberate BL-048 counter-example from a scrap build (decision §7). It needs a knowingly broken build — a Graphics inside layers.effects with the fence removed — and this step did not produce one; what stands in its place is the upstream check in tools/selftest/effects.ts ('Pixi still restores a blend mode it did not set'), which reads the defect out of the installed Pixi sources and fails the day an upgrade fixes it.

The cleaner's glint life shot (decision §7). The sparkle only fires for a cast role whose propWork is 'mop' (src/render/anim/cast.ts:109 is the only one), and no mop-carrying cleaner could be framed mid-stroke in the ?stress=12 scene during this session; two attempts detected the waiter's tray instead and were deleted rather than shipped as a sparkle.

The r5 sleeper re-capture (decision §7, BL-047). It was asked for because an S4 sleep mark would rise from a bed drawn as a «BED» placeholder. The channel no longer draws a sleep mark at all (§9 row 1), so the reason is gone; life-sleep-{full,lite}-desktop.png are the sleeper evidence this step has.
